source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of propositional satisfiability (PDF 30).

blocks.text: Propositional satisfiability jaanchti hai ke kya mantiqi expression sach ho sakta hai: kya kam az kam aik soorat hai jis mein woh sach ho. Yeh computer science mein, khaas taur par masla hal karne aur programming mein, mantiqi statements test karne, faisle karne, algorithms design karne aur programs ki tasdeeq ke liye aam use hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Mantiqi expression satisfiable hai agar use sach banane ka kam az kam aik tareeqa ho.

Proposition satisfiable hai agar truth values ka kam az kam aik milap use sach banaye. Agar har mumkin milap use jhoot banaye to woh unsatisfiable hai. Satisfiability expression ki banawat aur us ke connectives (AND, OR, NOT) par munhasir hai. Ise jaanchne ka aik tareeqa truth table ki har soorat dekhna hai: agar koi row sach ho to proposition satisfiable hai.

blocks.caption: Satisfiable aur unsatisfiable expressions
rows: Jab P ya Q sach ho to sach
Jab P aur Q dono sach hon to sach
P sach aur jhoot dono nahi ho sakta, is liye koi row sach nahi
'Pizza lao YA (burger lao AUR soda NA lao)'
Pizza lana aur soda na lana ise sach banata: hal maujood
'Pizza zaroor lao AUR pizza hargiz na lao'
Koi intikhab dono hisse sach nahi banata: hal nahi

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Ustad kai expressions dete hain aur talaba har aik ko satisfiable ya unsatisfiable mein taqseem karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya (P OR Q) AND (NOT P) AND (NOT Q) satisfiable hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. NOT P aur NOT Q ke liye P aur Q dono jhoot chahiye, lekin tab P OR Q jhoot hai, is liye har row jhoot aur expression unsatisfiable hai.

items: Satisfiable: qeematon ke kam az kam aik milap par sach.
Unsatisfiable: har milap par jhoot, jaise P AND NOT P.
Truth table ki rows dekh kar jaanchein.
